name: Woodway hyperscale data center pipeline
monitor_reason: no known state: the project is named by a sponsor with a public announcement, but the state is not disclosed, so the 'named project in a known state' leg of the data center add-threshold fails
researcher_notes: Woodway Energy Infrastructure announced on September 22, 2026 that it signed definitive agreements for a 22-mile, 30-inch natural gas pipeline. It will serve a power plant behind the meter for an unnamed hyperscale data center. Service is planned for the first half of 2028. Woodway describes itself as an owner of intrastate pipelines and is based in Houston. Press coverage points to Texas, but only as a guess from where Woodway's other assets are. The data center, the customer, the county and the state were not found in the press release, trade press, or search results. No existing row matches. Both sources are one press release reprinted, so they are not independent. Revisit when a state or county is named, for example in a Texas Railroad Commission filing.
